messages:
liz: Proposal: staggered migration for model-routing v2. Goal: roll new routing policy (region-aware + cost tiering) with minimal user-facing regressions. Need canary plan, A/B guardrails, and explicit fallback rules. asking for owners + sign-off by EOW :calendar:

sam: +1. which regions are in the first wave? EU + US only, or include APAC lite?

liz: start with EU + US to keep latency baselines comparable. APAC on second wave (we need VM sizing there). plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows with safety gates.

rado: suggest smaller initial slices: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. ramp if p95 latency delta <= 20ms and error-rate delta <= 0.1%. rollback if either metric crosses threshold for 5m.

manu: add quality guardrails too — compare token-level perplexity and a small eval prompt set for hallucination > threshold. customers care about quality more than tiny latency wins. Also include cost-per-1k-token delta alert.

anya: +customer ask note: enterprise-customers requested regional pinning + explicit audit log of rollouts. We need a field in the flag metadata: "customer_scope": ["orgA", "orgB"] and a way to opt out. this is high priority for sales.

deploy-bot: smoke-checks: staging routing-v2 passed basic smoke (latency p95 < 120ms, no exceptions). artifacts: build-2026.03.18.1357. :white_check_mark:

liz: rough rollout config (example):
```json
{
  "flag": "routing.v2",
  "waves": [
    {"region": "eu", "pct": 0.5, "duration_h": 12},
    {"region": "us", "pct": 2, "duration_h": 12},
    {"region": "global", "pct": 10, "duration_h": 24}
  ],
  "metrics": {"latency_p95_ms": 20, "error_rate_pct": 0.1},
  "fallback": "model.variant.small"
}
```

sam: minor tweak — make fallback a routing policy instead of explicit model id so we can route to cheapest compatible instance set. i.e. fallback: {"type":"variant","selection":"latency-first","max_model_size":"8B"}. quick example: 
```json
{"fallback": {"type": "variant", "selection": "latency-first", "max_model_size": "8B"}}
```

rado: big callout: KV-cache warming will tank p95 during rollout if we send new prefixes to new pool. plan to warm cache by duplicating a small percentage of traffic (shadowing) for 24h before >10% ramp. otherwise false positives.

manu: proposal for A/B holdback: create a 5% holdback group for the first week in each region to measure real customer impact vs baseline. Instrumentation: include per-route tagging: route.version, route.variant, experiment_id. we should surface cohort metrics in console (latency/cost/quality).

liz: owners: rollout owner = sam, metrics and observability = manu, customer opt-in flow = anya, infra controls = rado. tentative schedule: start canary Mon 03/23 08:00 UTC. sign-off by Fri 03/20 EOD. please ack or raise blockers. :eyes:
